rules.description: An individual may submit at most two applications per mobile number or email ID for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric schemes.
rules.condition: When applying for Pre-Matric or Post-Matric scholarships.
rules.outcome: The number of applications submitted using the same mobile number or email ID must not exceed two.
rules.evidence_quote: for Pre-Matric and Post-Matric- Maximum two applications per mobile no./email Id)
